newsitem.title: UK: BP names Chase as deputy chief executive.
newsitem.headline: BP names Chase as deputy chief executive.

text.p: British Petroleum Plc said on Thursday that Rodney Chase will become deputy group chief executive in January 1998.
The company said in a statement that Chase will relinquish responsibility for exploration and production and take charge of refining and marketing.

Richard Olver will take over responsibility for exploration and production from Chase. Olver will also become a managing director of the company from January 1998, while Chris Ginson-Smith obtains the same title in September, 1997.
BP also announced that Russell Seal and Rolf Stomberg will retire from the board on September 1, 1997 and January 1, 1998 respectively.
Stomberg will remain as a special adviser on European matters to chief executive John Browne.
